item.title: Critical Java Vulnerability Requires Immediate Patching
item.description:
Purpose

CISA strongly urges organizations to immediately patch the recently disclosed Oracle Java vulnerability CVE-2026-114938. This critical memory-corruption vulnerability, known as “Java4Shell,” affects the Base64 decoder of the x86-64 HotSpot Java Virtual Machine (JVM), which is part of the Java Development Kit (JDK). Specially crafted Base64 input could crash the JVM and allow for unauthenticated remote code execution.

Actions to take

CISA urges organizations to take the following actions:

  • Identify affected Java installations. Review your software inventory for JDKs and Java runtimes, including those bundled with third-party applications or included in container images and appliances. Note: JDKs and Java runtimes may not appear as separate entries in software inventories.
  • Apply relevant Java and vendor patches as soon as they are available, prioritizing internet-facing systems.
    • If immediate patching is not feasible, implement temporary compensating controls, such as restricting and validating Base64 input at the application boundary, enforcing input-size limits, and limiting unauthenticated access.

item.title: Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software
item.description:
View CSAF

Summary

Schneider Electric is aware of a vulnerability in its EcoStruxure™ Power Build Rapsody product. The EcoStruxure™ Power Build Rapsody is used to enter or import the single line diagram, to get the extensive bill of material of your switchboard, including all devices, connection items, and mounting components. Failure to apply the remediations provided below may risk memory corruption, heap-based buffer overflow, and/or stack-based buffer overflow, which could result in local attackers being able to exploit these issues to potentially execute arbitrary code.

The following versions of Schneider Electric EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software are affected:

  • EcoStruxure Power Build Rapsody software vers:generic/<=2.9.1.0_FR, 2.9.12.0101_FR, vers:generic/<=2.8.5.0301_ESP, 2.9.5.0000_ESP, vers:generic/<=2.8.7.0101_PT, 2.9.7.0000_PT, vers:generic/<=2.8.8.0201_BEL(FR), 2.9.8.0000_BELFR, vers:generic/<=2.8.3.0201_BEL(EN), 2.9.3.0000_BELEN, vers:generic/<=2.8.4.0401_INT(EN), 2.9.4.0000_INTEN, vers:generic/<=2.8.6.0000_INT(FR), 2.9.6.0000_INTFR, vers:generic/<=2.8.2.0000_NL, 2.9.6.0000_NL (CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055, CVE-2026-119055)
